assets.name: Papel Picado
assets.prompt: Generate an image of a question board. Wide landscape picture, 2:1 (twice as wide as tall), a rounded-corner board with a thick dark-brown outline frame, filling the whole picture. This is a question board that text will be written on, so the large middle of the board must stay calm and plain, with no objects, no patterns and nothing centered. Put the decorations only near the edges and corners, spread out with plenty of space between them, so the board still looks right if the middle is made a little wider. Scene: Warm sunny yellow background. A row of colorful cut-paper flags (pink, orange, turquoise, yellow, green, each with a different cut-out flower pattern) hangs along the top edge, spaced evenly. A pink hibiscus flower with leaves in the bottom-left corner and an orange hibiscus flower with leaves in the bottom-right corner. A narrow orange tile strip with small flower patterns runs along the bottom edge. Nothing else. Style: glossy cartoon sticker art in the same style as our game avatars, with thick dark-brown outlines, bright saturated colors, soft gradient shading and shiny highlights, friendly for all ages. Plain solid white background, no ground shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers.
